title: Download keys
key_points: A download key is a special URL that gives someone access to a project's files.
Keys can be generated for friends, press or bulk promotions.
External keys are available for owners of the project who also own external keys like Steam.
limitations: When someone downloads a free project a download key is not created.
A download key's URL should not be shared as it gives direct file access.
asserts: itch.io supports creators in distributing their games and projects through special URLs called download keys.
scope: The guide applies to how game developers on itch.io can distribute access to their projects, files, and external key integrations for different purchase scenarios.
